title: Ziffr Metric Description (ziffr.metric/1)
description: A Metric Description written as a file, without owner, Submitters or values: a Metric Catalog entry. It holds no code.

name.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

description.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

category.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses, such as “Revenue”

items.description: a key in lower case, such as “saas” or “b2b”

industries.description: The kinds of business, such as “saas” or “retail” it suits; left out, any.

items.description: a key in lower case, such as “saas” or “b2b”

segments.description: The kinds of customers, such as “b2b” or “b2c” it suits; left out, any.

period.description: How often it has a value.

aggregation.description: How its values combine over longer periods.

polarity.description: Whether higher, lower or a range of values is good.

unit.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses, such as “€” or “hours”

unitPosition.description: Which side of the number the unit stands on; left out, after.

valueFormat.description: What kind of number it counts; left out, number.

submissionRule.description: What a second value for the same period does; left out, overwrite.

targetMin.description: The lower end of its Target Range.

targetMax.description: The upper end of its Target Range.

attainmentMethod.description: How its Attainment is computed; left out, the Workspace's way.

sources.description: Where its values may arrive from; left out, every Source.

formula.description: a formula of + - * /, brackets, numbers and {key} of another entry, such as “{revenue} / {orders}”
